data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'Khawar', meaning 'to bloom' or 'to grow'. The name Khaperai carries the meaning “Blooming” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khaperai usually hope their child will grow to embody blooming and live with faith, good character and purpose.

It's believed that giving a child an evocative and culturally relevant name can play a significant role in shaping their identity and sense of belonging.
